en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historic villa or small castle set against a densely forested hillside. The building has steep, tiled roofs, ornate gables, half‑timbered upper sections, balconies, and a tall tower with a finial. In front is a terraced garden with paths, trees, and low stone walls. On the façade, decorative German script is visible above the entrance.
